comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: Has a nice taste, but somewhat unusual. Got my first taste at a PassionBerry, which is the same as any of the frozen yogurt businesses that popped up to cash in on the excess of the boom times. Many are probably no longer in business, but I'm not sure. Try Taro yourself if you can find it.
